name: Splunk - Malicious App Reverse Shell
command: tar -cvzf updater.tar.gz splunk_shell/   # upload via Manage Apps > Install app from file
description: Splunk runs scripted inputs from installed apps. Package an app whose inputs.conf runs a reverse-shell script (rev.py/run.ps1), upload it, and Splunk executes it - RCE as the Splunk user.
